raw_text: India summoned the Turkish ambassador following Erdogan's Kashmir remarks at the OIC summit. The Ministry of External Affairs described the comments as unwarranted and driven by domestic political considerations. Intelligence sources told Hindustan Times that the social media amplification campaign was pre-planned with bot networks activated across Telegram, X, and Bluesky.
clean_text: India summoned Turkish ambassador over Erdogan's OIC Kashmir remarks. MEA calls comments unwarranted. Intelligence sources confirm pre-planned social media amplification with bot networks.
